name: Alchemist Arcane Alchemist
body:
“You should not be surprised that alchemy can add such arcane properties to a weapon.”

As an arcane alchemist, you have the following class feature.

Arcane Pool (Su)

Your alchemist level stacks with your magus level for the purpose of the arcane pool magus class feature. If you have no magus class levels, you gain the arcane pool ability as if you were a magus of your alchemist level. Your arcane pool refreshes once per day when you either prepare extracts or prepare spells. This replaces mutagen.
